title: functions.executions.request.FunctionRemoteProfileRemoteRequestBody
description:
Base request body with common execution parameters.

Used directly for remote Function + remote Profile, or flattened into
other request body types.

retry_token.description: If present, reuses votes from a previous execution with this token.

from_cache.description: If true, uses cached votes when available.

strategy.description:
Execution strategy.
Defaults to `Default` strategy if not specified.

input.description: The input data to pass to the Function.

mcp_server_authorization.description: Map from MCP server URL to authorization header value.
